Let me run the decisive test: step13 (likely just slow) and probe_s1/p2 (`a.sameSide c BD`) with large timeouts. If p2 diverges, step8's direct approach is hopeless and I'll pivot to a construction-based strategy.

<<<RUN cwd=LeanEuclidPlus>>>
source ~/.venvs/leaneuclid/bin/activate; export PATH="$HOME/.elan/bin:$PATH"; for spec in "step13 1200" "p2 1000"; do set -- $spec; t=$1; to=$2; echo "===== $t (timeout ${to}s) ====="; /usr/bin/time -v timeout $to lake build Book1.Prop47.$t > /tmp/lt_$t.log 2>&1; echo "exit=$?"; grep -iE "error|unsolved|sorry|Elapsed" /tmp/lt_$t.log | grep -v "Prop41/Main" | head -6; done; echo ALLDONE
<<<END>>>
